<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The file is a simple shell wrapper script for launching the Mindustry server application. It uses `exec` to replace the current shell process with a Java execution that runs the server-release.jar file, passing through any command-line arguments (`$@`). This is a standard and expected pattern for binary launcher scripts in AUR packages - it allows users to execute the server like `mindustry-server-bin.sh [args]` while actually running the Java application directly. The script only operates on files within the package's own installation directory (`/usr/share/java/mindustry-server/`) and requires Java to be pre-installed on the system. There are no network requests, file downloads, obfuscated code, or system modifications - it's purely a launcher that delegates to the upstream application.
</details>
